# /golden — run a golden case + normalized diff

Thin macro over the **existing** golden runner. Do NOT re-implement golden/normalize/diff logic —
`tools.golden_runner.runner` already shares the §4-5 normalization core (a second comparator would
drift, Pitfall P4).

## Invocation

The golden case id is taken from `$ARGUMENTS` and passed **positionally** to the runner module.
The runner spawns the .NET toy converter with `subprocess.run([list], shell=False)` — arguments are
never concatenated into a shell string (command-injection guard, T-03-13):

!`python -m tools.golden_runner.runner $ARGUMENTS`

## Semantics

- **exit 0** → PASS (normalized output equals the approved `.verified` baseline; repr-only diffs
  are absorbed by the shared normalization core).
- **exit 1** → FAIL (a value regression); the runner writes a machine-proposed
  `baseline.received.tsv` and **never** overwrites the human-approved `.verified` baseline (P9).

To promote a proposed baseline after review, use `/golden-approve` — an agent must never self-bless.

## Notes

- The .NET spawn is presence-gated inside the runner; the normalize+diff path is proven without a
  live .NET runtime.
